notes.title: Lovecraftian festival BIG Munch rework, polish, bug fixes patch
notes.notes:
Hey all, We've done a big overhaul of the game, so this update includes some major changes along with bug fixes and polishing.  Would love to know what you think! 
We're already working on a few more bug fixes and polish for the next update. 

If you want to keep on supporting us, please leave a Steam review, it really helps!  \m/

-------

Important:
Since there are a lot of big changes, your old save file might cause some problems. I suggest deleting your old save file via the Options menu to avoid any issues.

Game Structure & Progression

 Revamped Game Progression: We replaced the old Objectives-based structure with a vertical progression to make it clearer how to progress.
 Islands Update: We replaced the old large maps with smaller focused areas. 

Gameplay Changes

 Reworked Munch Mechanic: Instead of devouring countless small spheres, you now consume a single, big chunk of food as a reward. It’s faster and far less tedious.
 New Progression Indicators: During loading screens, you’ll now see your run progression, highlighting which evolutions you’ve yet to try and how far along you are.
 Knockback added: Smaller enemies now get launched by your heavy blows.
 Improved Player Feedback: New visual effects for taking damage and receiving altered states have been added.
 UI Overhaul: Every interface has been redesigned and polished to meet a higher quality standard. Updated sections include the HUB, Pause Menu, Loading Screen, Main Menu, and the new Map Screen.
 Limb Upgrades Rework: This underused mechanic has been revised. Each evolution now leads to secondary effects tied to abilities, adding depth to your build choices.
 Full Game Rebalance: Some trait and enhancement combinations previously resulted in overpowered builds capable of one-shotting everything. We've fine-tuned values to make planning and different builds more rewarding.
 Simplified Healing: Healing Orbs are now automatically absorbed by the player.

Bug Fixes

 Tentacles are now visible again.
 Lava puddles no longer permanently slow the player.
 Fixed the Reroll enhancement: it now allows a limited number of rerolls per run.
 Fixed the Sacrificial Lamb enhancement: headbangers now reach and damage all enemies as intended.
 Key rebinding in the Options menu now works properly.
 The player no longer gets permanently frozen after devouring something.
 Painkiller should no longer gets stuck when performing its initial abilities.
 Thug enemies' counterattacks now trigger correctly.
 Dialogues now fully display during first-time interactions instead of being skipped.
 Bugs related to consuming food and Healing Orbs have been resolved as part of the rework.
 Evolutions no longer result in the wrong creature.
 Secondary objective bugs have been addressed and fixed as part of the rework.
 Bestiary models are now fully visible.
 Nekrab's healing ability now plays the correct animation.
 Enemies no longer spawn underground.

notes.title: Next patch in the works, and a new demo
notes.notes:
Hey there, 
We took some holiday time post-release, and during that time we starting working on a new smaller game to keep the studio going, but we are still planning the next patch for Munch.

We’ve been pulling together a list of things to fix, and a few things have come up regularly that we're prioritizing, stuff like:

- Invisible tentacles
- Perma slow puddles 
- Soft-lock on Painkiller’s ability
- Key rebinding issues (we thought we’d fixed this, but seems to still bug out sometimes)
- Some UI issues
- Canopyus teleport …quirks 
- Other visual glitches and bugs of course

And some design / balancing tweaks we might squeeze in. 

So more fixes and updates are coming..!

notes.title: Patch 1.53 with Bug Fixes (mostly)
notes.notes:
A smaller bug patch we updated on Friday Nov 30, since they took a little longer to solve. 

Here's what's changed, mostly so Ordo stops going into unintentional God-mode:


 Fixed Ordo not getting damage after the arena
 Fixed crash happening after defeating Ordo
 Fixed some resurrected scouts on Ordo's fight not being ghosts
 Fixed minimap icon taking a while to disappear after killing an enemy


Note these aren't updated on the Mac build yet - a little behind there, but it will be in a couple of days.
More coming, but we wanted to get these ones out the door as soon as we figured them out!

notes.title: Patch 1.5 with Bug Fixes and small QOL tweaks
notes.notes:
Hey folks, 

Still keeping up with more frequent updates with fewer changes, rather than less frequent but larger updates, at least while we iron out more of the annoying bugs.

So a few more fixes and changes:


 Fixed enemies becoming invincible if they were stunned with the same hit that killed them
 Fixed some enemies getting stuck without attacking when trying to reach an unreachable point in the map
 Fixed various issues with various Apex Creature traits
 Health orbs are now visible behind objects
 Added the missing lights from the Guide, no more creatures in the dark
 Some minor art tweaks to vfx and health bars


And in case you missed the minor update a couple of days ago:


 We've added Steam achievements! 
 We also added and updated some objectives


More soon!

notes.title: Quick patch to fix language selection and some crashes
notes.notes:
This is a quick mid-patch fix:


 Language selection is now fixed for Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean
 Esc key now allows you to navigate back to previous screens, and also closes the pause menu
 Fixed a crash that would happen when opening the pause menu (typically for players that had a relic active)


Previous patch had these fixed:


 Enemies no longer freeze if skip cutscenes is enabled
 Relics now deactivate properly
 Added delete save button
 Enemies should no longer spawn in unreachable places 
 Beast Lair objectives should now complete properly when all the enemies have been killed
 [strike]Lava puddles no longer slow you permanently[/strike] This still happens, but stepping in a puddle again removes the debuff
 Added missing SFX
 Your monster should no longer be invisible after being revived by the Last Burst trait
 Resolved some issues with Devouring an enemy whole
 Fixed main menu music stopping randomly
 Loading time and performance improvements
 Minor UI improvements


AND players can now access Ördo, The World Father, by completing the objective to Free the Gods in these steps:

Step 1 - Do a run acquiring 6 traits of the same type and go to the relevant prison in Era 3 (whichever colour you have 6 of). 
Step 2 - Defeat the horde/boss that spawns near the prison. This will destroy the prison and free one of the Gods. This will also end the run. 
Step 3 - Repeat Steps 1-2 for the other 2 sets of traits, freeing each God in turn.
Step 4 - Once all Gods are free, on a new run, activate all 3 prisons by attacking each of them.
Step 5 - Once all 3 prisons are activated, defeat the boss at the end of the run and you'll be transported to Ördo.

Content related updates:

ÖRDO HAS ARRIVED!

Free the Gods of Metal and then defeat Ordo to let Metal reign supreme!

There is an objective to follow to reach him. You should see the ‘Choose 6 Traits of the same type’ which will unlock the next part of the content to begin to free the Gods in the 3rd Era, and then eventually meet their Maker.

But here are the Steps in case the clues from Tiamat are not clear:

Step 1 - Do a run acquiring 6 traits of the same type and go to the relevant prison in Era 3 (whichever colour you have 6 of). 
Step 2 - Defeat the horde/boss that spawns near the prison. This will destroy the prison and free one of the Gods. This will also end the run. 
Step 3 - Repeat Steps 1-2 for the other 2 sets of traits, freeing each God in turn.
Step 4 - Once all Gods are free, on a new run, activate all 3 prisons by attacking each of them.
Step 5 - Once all 3 prisons are activated, defeat the boss at the end of the run and you'll be transported to Ördo.

More to update next week!

notes.title: Working on 1st patch with updates!
notes.notes:
Before we launched we already had a series of fixes and updates planned.
We're also reading all the feedback on the discussion forum, discord and review pages. We know the game is not quite meeting expectations yet and there's a lot of work to do, but we're on it!

Here's what we're working on updating immediately:

PLANNED TO BE FIXED IN THE NEXT PATCH

- General performance improvements like some loading times are long on the last Era
- If you have Skip Cutscenes enabled, the enemies will be frozen until you use 'Devour'
- When fighting a mini-boss, the Arena may spawn late and lock the game if you've killed the boss already. (Workaround: don't kill the boss before the arena spawns)
- If you activate the Prison and move too far away, the Arena it will spawn without you inside it (Workaround: do not move too far from the prison after activating it)
- Some SFX dropped out
- Some traits don't appear in your mutation list, but they do work in game
- Resolution can only be changed via mouse (when using KB+M)
- A bunch of more minor glitches
- Language fixes for Japanese, Korean and Chinese - these broke last minute :*( 

STILL INVESTIGATING / IN FUTURE PATCH

- Ordered Chaos Relic does not unlock
- Sometimes when approaching the Flesh Crystal, the game may crash
- Enemy spawning glitches
- Painkiller's 2nd ability animation may get stuck in a pose (Workaround: you can dash out of it)
- Sometimes clearing the lair does not complete the objective, no matter how hard you try
- Lava puddles sometimes slow you permanently, like a bad trip
- Sometimes enemies don't explode when they die, but trust me they are dead
- An random enemy might become invincible (Workaround: run away, far away)
- Sometimes the Sacrificial Lamb trait may spawn a headbanger who is not motivated to sacrifice themselves
- Occasionally the Moshpitter enhancement may not trigger 

This list will be kept updated here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2427050/discussions/0/4629230935430224425/

Interested in what additional content is already planned, check it out here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2427050/discussions/0/4629230935430224678/

notes.title: Demo update with new level, some teasers and other fixes!
notes.notes:
We've been working on the full game ready for our release later this year. But in the meantime we merged a few changes into the demo based on the beta playtesting:


 Level updated with the new look, and hints at other biomes and enemies available from the full game. Some parts of this are blocked off. The level still stays the same each run, unlike in the full game where it is randomized.
 Many more mutations are available now, from Ore, Flesh and Nekro builds. You can still only evolve into pure Flesh or Flesh/Nekro monsters, but the new traits let you experiment with other builds.
 General updates to combat, animations, VFX and SFX
 Note the Japanese, Korean, Chinese translations are missing some descriptions, but we're adding these soon!


Next update should have some UI and Music changes :)

Rock on!

notes.title: May demo update - more monsters, more upgrades, more metal.
notes.notes:
We're hard at work on the main production of Munch, but decided to add a few more things to the demo in time for the Endless Replayability Steam fest. 

Here's a few things we've added and fixed.

New stuff:

 A new enemy type: the scout (ranged)
 A new playable monster: Morbideath - a Nekro/Flesh hybrid. Since it's a hybrid, it has mixed characteristics - a bit of melee, a bit of ranged, but still 100% metal. To access it, make sure you choose a few Nekro mutations
 A new type of upgrade: Relics that can be acquired once you reach the second Era (only 1 in the demo)
 A new type of upgrade: Special limb attachments with power effects. Get these by fulling mutating your character in each era.
 11 new mutations to select, from the Nekro branch
 Healing orbs now drop from some secondary objectives and buildings. Munch on these bad boys to recover some HP


We also think we fixed these things, but you never really know:

[olist]
 Abilities now have their cooldown countdowns
 Enemies now explode properly instead of freezing in a death pose
 Fixed character getting stuck after dashing
 Fixed some UI navigation issues
 Thugs now perform their special abilities properly
 Fixed Gutpuncher's stun that sometimes wouldn't stun
 Peasants no longer get stuck running away from you
 Destructible props should break properly now (and drop a little treat)
 Some other visual fixes you probably didn't even notice
 Some balancing
[/olist]

As always, feedback is very much needed :)
We'll have a beta test in the next couple of months with most of the playable characters, enemies and real procedural level generation etc.
Until then we'll likely do another demo update with some level and environment changes, balancing etc.

Roof
